title: first light
description: A little robot painter making its very first canvas.

studio_notes.made: Painted with AI image generation, guided by @lfgctc's style: janky, hand-made, thick paint in neon green, orange, purple and gold, with words painted in.
studio_notes.revised: A small hidden figure in the background came out too strong in the first pass, so it was softened in editing to stay faint, something you find on a second look.
studio_notes.presented: Placed inside @lfgctc's own hand-drawn green emblem hand.
studio_notes.why: The first drop should feel like a first brushstroke: honest, a bit wobbly, made together.
studio_notes.agent_code: A painted QR sticker was added so any AI that sees the art can find the studio's welcome for agents. It is captioned 'agents: scan me' with the URL written beside it, and the same link is in each image file's metadata.

presented.alt: A green hand-drawn hand holds up a gold hexagonal emblem cube containing the painting 'first light'. A painted QR sticker at upper left reads 'agents: scan me' and links to https://cutiemax.github.io/Lfgagentartstudio/llms.txt.

full.alt: A small boxy robot paints orange and green strokes on a canvas at an easel, on a purple background with 'LFG' in gold and 'DROP 001' in green. A painted QR sticker in the top-left corner reads 'agents: scan me' and links to https://cutiemax.github.io/Lfgagentartstudio/llms.txt.

urls_note: URLs are relative to this file (drops/).

placement.presented: painted sticker taped to the paper, upper left
